newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Krajisnik condemns war crimes court sentence.
newsitem.headline: Krajisnik condemns war crimes court sentence.

text.p: A Bosnian Serb leader condemned the jailing of Dusan Tadic by the U.N. war crimes tribunal on Monday as a political act.

"This is a political sentence ... We are very bitter that care was not taken to put this trial on a better political foundation," said Momcilo Krajisnik, Serb member of Bosnia's postwar multi-ethnic collective presidency.

"This is another confirmation that people are being tried with incomplete information," Krajisnik, a close ally of former Bosnian Serb president Radovan Karadzic who is also wanted for war crimes, told reporters.
Tadic was jailed for 20 years by the U.N. court, which sits in the Netherlands, for his part in the ethnic cleansing of Moslems and Croats in northern Bosnia at the start of the war in 1992.
